name: Cape Cadogan Boutique Hotel
positioning: Restored 1800s National Monument turned boutique hotel in Cape Town's Kloof Street Neighbourhood in Gardens, with Table Mountain rising behind
best_for: Travelers who want to explore Cape Town's galleries, restaurants and shops on foot
Families wanting two-bedroom suites and a kids' programme
Small groups wanting a private villa with its own pool

facts.text: The hotel is in the Kloof Street Neighbourhood in Gardens, Cape Town, with Table Mountain rising behind.
Galleries, restaurants and independent shops are a five-minute walk from the hotel.
The hotel is twenty minutes from the airport.
Interiors blend Bohemian chic with contemporary cool.
The hotel has two temperature-controlled pools and a fitness centre.
Luxury Rooms have their own private sun terrace.
Each Stable Suite has a lounge area and kitchenette, and some have courtyards or Juliet balconies.
Family Stable Suites have two-bedroom configurations and interleading options.
Upstairs rooms have Table Mountain views from small view balconies.
Rates include a full breakfast made to order at Upper Union Restaurant, plus afternoon drinks and canapes.
Rates include access to the Mack & Madi kids' programme.
The hotel arranges helicopter flights over Cape Town's Atlantic coastline and mountains.

highlights.text: The hotel is a restored National Monument dating from the 1800s: an original 19th-century Georgian house with Victorian influences.
The wellness centre features TheraVine Cape botanical treatments from the surrounding winelands.
Superior Luxury Rooms have separate lounge areas, private sun terraces, and en-suite bathrooms with both bath and shower.
The Cape Cadogan villa has three bedrooms, a private pool, a full kitchen and a breakfast chef.
Guests can join a community experience visiting Injongo Educare Centre in Mfuleni township, where shipping containers become classrooms.

considerations.text: An Impact Levy of R160 per room per night is not included in the rate.
This is a city hotel: double glazing on all the windows is there to muffle city sounds.
